0.original: Sukegei has been abandoned by his favorite sheep.

24.original: Use the blowgun to shoot the lost lamb from the designated location.

26.original: Deliver the lost lamb to Sukegei.

48.original: Don't suppose you have time to chase after a sheep do you? My most cowardly one just ran off after hearing a nearby beast's roar.

49.original: She is so timid she is likely to run away if you try to approach her normally.

50.original: Take this blowgun and these darts that I've laced with a sedative. One hit and she will be out in an instant. She ran off somewhere to the west. Best of luck!

51.original: Use that blowgun I gave you to put my sheep to sleep. She ran off somewhere to the west. Best of luck!

53.original: The lost lamb is wary of your presence.

54.original: You are going to need to put her to sleep first if you are to have any chance of catching her.

55.original: Did you manage to catch my sheep?

56.original: Oh, thank you! You had me worried sick you did, deary.

57.original: This job means everything to me. It truly does.

58.original: I was just a lonely orphan with nowhere to call my own when the Mol took me in. I said I would look after our sheep in an attempt to show my gratitude.

59.original: My heart nearly stopped when this little one ran away. Sheep are the cornerstone of our tribe's way of life.

60.original: I fear I will never be able to truly express my thanks to you, but know I am grateful.
